meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上后会通过 Exa 做网络搜索和 URL 内容提取:搜索时可限定学术论文类别或学术域名,也可批量抓取网页、文章、学术 PDF。查科学/技术主题时优先采用学术来源。
howto.when: 当用户提出搜索、查找、获取网页内容等请求时触发,尤其涉及科学或技术话题。

say.text: 帮我搜一下量子计算的最新进展
say.note: 触发网络搜索并偏向学术来源

say.text: 提取这篇文章的内容并总结:https://example.com/paper
say.note: 用 Web Extract 抓取该 URL

say.text: 查找 Nature 上关于阿尔茨海默病的研究论文

howto.what_en: Gives Claude web search via Exa (semantic lookups, research, current info) with optional 'research paper' category and academic domain filtering, plus batch extraction of webpages, articles, and academic PDFs. Prefers scholarly sources for scientific/technical topics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article, especially for scientific or technical topics.

say_en.text: Search the web for the latest progress in quantum computing.
say_en.note: Runs web search with academic emphasis.

say_en.text: Extract this article and summarize it: https://example.com/paper
say_en.note: Uses Web Extract on that URL.

say_en.text: Find research papers on Alzheimer's disease in Nature.
